tricks.trick: TISSUE = Team In Same Shape Under Equal-work — same shape + same work = ऊतक.

tricks.concept: पौधे और जंतुओं के ऊतकों में अंतर
tricks.trick: P-DEAD, A-LIVE: Plants need Dead support tissues; Animals mostly Living tissues.
A-L-I: Apical Length, Lateral (cambium) thickness, Intercalary at Internodes.
M → D → P: Meristem Divides then becomes Permanent after Differentiation.
PCS: Parenchyma Stores, Collenchyma Bends (flexible), Sclerenchyma Stones (hard dead).
E-S-C: Epidermis Shields, Stomata Swap gases, Cork with suBerin Blocks.

tricks.trick: XYLEM = 'Zail' से पानी Upper; PHLOEM = 'Flow' of Food from leaves.
E-C-M-N: Epithelial Covers, Connective Connects (blood too!), Muscle Moves, Nerve Messages.
